faq.title: Questions about Vazne
items: Vazne (وزنه) is a strength-training companion for iOS and Android. It brings workout plans, weight and rep logging, rest timing and progress records together, in English and Persian.
Can I import my coach’s plan?
Yes. Vazne supports photo, text and manual entry. Review the exercises, sets and reps and correct any import mistakes before you start.
Vazne is in testing. On iPhone, install it with TestFlight. On Android, join the closed test on Google Play; the steps are on vazne.app/test. Features may change between test versions.
Does this website save my workout?
No. The barbell and set controls are an interactive demonstration. They do not create an account or save a workout.
The app is in English and Persian. This website is also in Arabic and Spanish: pick a language from the menu at the top.
How do I get help or delete my account?
Email support@vazne.app. The delete account page explains the steps, and the privacy policy explains how app information is handled.
